ui_example_intro_description: Pick an example on the left. This panel describes what to try, the Properties panel tweaks it live and Output shows the events.
ui_example_basic_button_description: Click the button and watch the click event in the Output. Uncheck Enabled to block the input.
ui_example_basic_button_double_click_des: Click twice quickly: both on_click and on_double_click fire, check their order in the Output.
ui_example_basic_button_hold_description: Hold the button for 2 seconds. on_hold_callback drives the fill, on_long_click fires at the end.
ui_example_basic_text_description: Drag the corners of the text area, switch Adjust and Pivot to see how the text fits into the box.
ui_example_basic_multiline_text_descript: The same, but with line breaks. Shrink the area and see where the text wraps and how it scales down.
ui_example_basic_hover_description: The left node reacts to touch hover, the right one to mouse hover. Use mouse_callback for mouse events.
ui_example_basic_drag_description: Drag the node around. On release it animates back to the start position from on_drag_end.
ui_example_basic_drag_to_node_descriptio: Drag the node over the zone: it highlights on hover and the counter grows when you drop it inside.
ui_example_basic_slider_description: Drag the pin or click anywhere on the bar: set_input_node makes the whole widget interactive.
ui_example_basic_slider_vertical_descrip: The same slider, the direction is set by the end position vector passed on creation.
ui_example_basic_slider_stepped_descript: Slider with set_steps: the pin snaps to the nearest of the 11 fixed values.
ui_example_basic_progress_bar_descriptio: Change the value with the slider on the right, the bar is filled by the node size.
ui_example_basic_progress_bar_slice9_des: The same bar with slice9: the fill keeps its rounded edges even at small values.
ui_example_basic_blocker_description: The whole panel is clickable, but the blocker zone eats the input. Click both areas and compare the Output.
ui_example_basic_back_handler_descriptio: Press Backspace or the Android back button: the back handler calls the callback, the text reacts.
ui_example_basic_timer_description: The timer counts down to zero, then on_timer_end restarts it with a longer interval.
ui_example_basic_hotkey_description: Press Shift + X. The modifier is a part of the combination, the hotkey fires only with it.
ui_example_basic_scroll_description: Drag the content or use the wheel. Tune friction, inertion and elastic stretch on the right.
ui_example_basic_scroll_nested_descripti: The wheel picks the view under the cursor. Turn off Inner Scrollable: the content fits and the wheel goes to the outer scroll.
ui_example_basic_scroll_slider_descripti: Scroll and slider are bound both ways. Drag any of them, or click an item to scroll to it.
ui_example_basic_grid_description: Add and remove elements, change the number in a row and watch how the grid places the nodes.
ui_example_basic_scroll_bind_grid_descri: The bound grid updates the scroll size. Add or remove elements and watch the content size below.
ui_example_basic_scroll_bind_grid_horizo: The same binding with a single row grid, so the scroll becomes horizontal.
ui_example_basic_scroll_bind_grid_points: Points of interest are taken from the grid: on release the scroll snaps to the nearest item.
ui_example_basic_scroll_bind_grid_cards_: Cards snap to points and scale by the distance to the center. Switch them by scroll or arrows.
ui_example_layout_scroll_bind_cards_desc: Cards of a random width in a layout. The scroll is bound to the layout and still snaps to each card.
ui_example_basic_input_description: Click to type, Enter to apply. The text is trimmed: compare text and visual in the Output.
ui_example_whitelist_blacklist_descripti: Whitelist and blacklist limit which components receive input, children included.
ui_example_scoped_filters_description: Two filter levels at once: the example filters both panels, each panel filters itself, and the filters stack.
ui_example_input_password_description: The password field shows dots on the screen, while get_text still returns the real value.
ui_example_basic_rich_input_description: Input with a placeholder and a moving cursor. Click the field and type, the cursor follows the text.
ui_example_basic_rich_text_description: One string with tags becomes several nodes: colors and fonts are mixed inside a single text.
ui_example_rich_text_tags_description:
Built-in tags in action:
 - <color=A1D7F5>color</color>
 - font
 - size
 - br
 - img
ui_example_rich_text_split_animated_desc: set_split_to_characters makes a node per letter, so each letter is animated separately.
ui_example_rich_text_resize_description: Move the width and height sliders: the text rewraps and scales down to fit the area.
ui_example_basic_swipe_description: Swipe over the area: the hint moves to the swipe side. Uncheck Enabled to stop the gestures.
ui_example_checkbox_description: A checkbox made from a Druid button: the click toggles the icon and plays the select effect.
ui_example_checkbox_group_description: Three independent checkboxes, the group logs all states on every change.
ui_example_radio_group_description: The same checkboxes, but only one stays on: a click resets the others.
ui_example_data_list_basic_description: 1000 items, but only the visible ones exist as nodes. Watch the visual indexes while scrolling.
ui_example_data_list_horizontal_basic_de: The same virtualization for a horizontal list: the grid has a single row.
ui_example_data_list_matrix_basic_descri: Data list over a grid with 4 in a row: nodes are created only for the visible rows.
ui_example_data_list_add_remove_clear_de: Add, remove and clear items with the buttons. A click on an item removes it by index.
ui_example_data_list_cache_with_componen: With set_use_cache the components are reused: on_element_add and on_element_remove fill the data.
ui_example_window_language_description: Change the language: every lang_text is re-translated at once, the whole example included.
ui_confirmation_description: Confirm buy the one million dollar car?
ui_example_window_information_text: You are the best of the best!
ui_example_window_information_descriptio: A window widget with one button and a Panthera open and close animation.
ui_example_widget_hover_hint_description: Hover a box and wait a bit: the hint appears at the given side and fits its size to the text.
ui_example_widget_property_button_descri: The button row used by the Properties panel on the right.
ui_example_widget_property_slider_descri: The slider row used by the Properties panel on the right.
ui_example_widget_property_checkbox_desc: The checkbox row used by the Properties panel on the right.
ui_example_widget_memory_panel_descripti: The widget samples the memory usage and draws it as a mini graph.
ui_example_widget_fps_panel_description: The widget tracks the FPS and draws the last seconds as a mini graph.
ui_example_widget_mini_graph_description: A bar graph with a set number of samples, used by the FPS and memory panels.
ui_example_widget_properties_panel_descr: The panel itself: add buttons, sliders, checkboxes and inputs to control an example.
ui_example_widget_property_input_descrip: The text input row used by the Properties panel on the right.
ui_example_gamepad_tester_description: Connect a gamepad: the buttons light up, the sticks move and the triggers fill the bars.
ui_example_widget_tiling_node_descriptio: The tiling node keeps the texture tiled while the node is resized or animated.
ui_example_on_screen_control_description: Drag the stick to move the character and tap the button to make it jump. Multitouch is supported.
ui_example_layout_basic_description: Change padding, margins, justify, pivot and the layout type to see how the elements are placed.
ui_example_panthera_basic_animation_desc: A Panthera animation over GUI nodes, created from the runtime and played in a loop.
ui_example_panthera_animation_blend_desc: The animation time is set by hand: the cursor position blends between the animation keys.
ui_example_container_anchors_description: Drag the corners of the parent: each child keeps its own anchor and relative position.
ui_example_container_resize_description: Drag the corners: the side panels stretch by X or Y and the content resizes with the parent.
